plain_description.what: It paired two existing analyses anchor by anchor. One built the tree on MMLU-Pro alone, the other on several benchmarks pooled together. It counted how many of the 14 MMLU-Pro topics certify in each. No calls were made.
plain_description.why: It tests a standing claim that pooling benchmarks roughly halves MMLU-Pro's certified structure.
plain_description.information: If true, multi-benchmark trees would lose structure. If false, the cost lies elsewhere. Result: done. The 'halved' claim is withdrawn: 3 vs 5 of 14, p = 0.625. What pooling costs is questions, not separation. MMLU-Pro math questions get absorbed into the MATH benchmark's cells. This supports building each benchmark separately and then combining them.
